ruling.recommended_action: Refund S$4.51 (voucher) for the unexempt deviation distance; no account flag (driver's 90-day upheld route disputes = 0).
ruling.reasoning:
Safety screen: chat is only pickup logistics; complaint and driver statement contain no threat, harassment or dangerous-driving allegation → safety_concern none.

Service type is RydeTAXI, so the fare is metered and extra distance directly inflates the fare (policy §0). The quoted route is 21.21 km; the GPS trace shows the driver left the optimal route around 09:24–09:25 (from ~1.3091,103.9338 the trace turns south instead of continuing north-east on the ECP corridor) and remained off it until roughly 09:30–09:31 (returning to the corridor near 1.3113,103.9421), including a reversal at ~09:25:30–09:29:00 where the trace heads back west/south (1.3142,103.9342 → 1.3169,103.9469 → 1.3113,103.9421). Metered distance was 24.41 km vs 21.21 km quoted → 3.20 km of extra distance, closely matching the rider's "meter read 24 km". The two long westward/southward legs of that excursion are ≈ 3.2 km, consistent with the whole excess residing in the single off-route segment (the return via Airport Boulevard is the optimal-road mileage, so it is not double-counted).

No exemption applies. The driver only says "the GPS sent me; it rerouted", which is not a rider request under RD-3; there is no rider-named stop; no chat message before 09:24 grants consent (RD-5), and the record shows no general route authority or verbal agreement (driver's unrecorded claim of agreement would not count). The traffic record has only band-5 speed entries on ECP/Airport Boulevard (free-flowing) and no incidents at all, so RD-4 gives no reasonable cause for the ECP-corridor stretch — and even the one band-5 section tracked is on the shortest route itself, which the driver partially left.

Amount (RD-2, metered branch): unexempt extra_km 3.20 × per-km rate (distance_fare ÷ distance_km = 34.42 ÷ 24.41 = 1.4101) = S$4.51, rounded to the cent. Waiting time (0) is unaffected.

RD-6 flag is not triggered: the driver's route_disputes_upheld_90d = 0, so this case does not make it "repeated".

segment_findings.reason: Off-route excursion ~09:24–09:31 (trace leaves the ECP/optimal corridor near 1.3091,103.9338, heads south, then doubles back west at ~09:26–09:29 before rejoining the corridor near 1.3113,103.9421); ≈3.2 km of extra travel accounts for the whole 24.41 vs 21.21 km excess. No rider consent message before 09:24 (RD-5), no rider-named stop (RD-3), traffic is band 5 / no incidents (RD-4) → not exempt; RD-1 unexempt deviation, RD-2 refund.

rejected_claims.reason: A driver's own claim that the GPS rerouted him does not create a rider-agreed route change; Ryde requires a mutual agreement before departing from the route (RD-5, A7), and no such rider message exists. Traffic facts show free-flowing conditions and no incidents on the substituted stretch (RD-4).
Any implicit claim of verbal agreement is not consent; only a rider's own message sent before the detour counts (RD-5 / G11).
Accepted in substance but capped by policy: refund is limited to unexempt extra_km × per-km rate (RD-2), i.e. S$4.51, not the full difference in displayed distance/fare.
